sections.t: CTET Primary Level (Class I to V) Eligibility with Code

r.p:
• Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education OR
• Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 2- year Diploma in Elementary Education as per NCTE 2002 Norms OR
• Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 4- year Bachelor of Elementary Education (B.El.Ed) OR
• Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 2- year Diploma in Education (Special Education)

sections.t: CTET Junior Level (Class VI to VIII) Eligibility with Code

r.p:
• Bachelor Degree and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (by whatever name known). OR
• At least 50% marks either in Graduation or in Post-Graduation and passed or appearing in final year Bachelor in Education (B.Ed). OR
• Graduation with at least 45% marks and passed or appearing in 1-year Bachelor in Education (B.Ed), in accordance with the NCTE Norms OR
• Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 4- year Bachelor in Elementary Education (B.El.Ed). OR
• Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 4- year B.A/B.Sc.Ed or B.A.Ed/B.Sc.Ed

r.p:
Eligibility for Change / Update RRB NTPC Bank Details
• Candidate must have appeared in Railway NTPC Exam will be eligible for this refund process. Those who have not participated in this examination will not be eligible.
• NTPC recruitment exam conducted by the Railway Recruitment Board was held from 28 December 2020 to 31 July 2021 in a total of 07 phases .
• Railway Board has issued a new notice today on 06 August that the candidates who have participated in the online CBT exam should check their bank details again, if there is any change in their bank account like bank name, IFSC. The code or any other information should be updated in the website of Railway Board between 11 August 2021 t

(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
NTPC Railway How to Update / Correction Bank Details
• The candidate has to make an online request to update/change his/her bank details.
• Candidates can view, update, change their bank details between August 11 and August 31.
• The candidate will have to enter his/her registration number along with the date of birth to view, update or change any information such as bank details.
• The bank details given by the candidate about 02 years ago will be present in the dashboard, the candidate should once again match it with his bank account, if there is any change, then update it online immediately.
• After checking all the information, save it
